title: Mul 2019 autism, looming sound and tactile PPS
citation: Mul, C., Cardini, F., Stagg, S. D., Sadeghi Esfahlani, S., Kiourtsoglou, D., Cardellicchio, P., & Aspell, J. E. (2019). Altered bodily self-consciousness and peripersonal space in autism. Autism, 23(8), 2055–2067.
notes: A 65-trial inspection for the audio-tactile PPS task, with 50 tap-present trials and 15 sound-only catches. The published setup used a mechanical tapper and physical loudspeakers. The published full-body illusion was a separate task.

reference_parameters.source_scope: Audio-tactile hand PPS assessment before the separately administered full-body illusion.

reported_design.sample_difference: Two non-autistic PPS records were excluded after equipment malfunction.
reported_design.order: Intermixed target and catch trials in randomized order.

sound.placement: Near loudspeaker beside the right hand and far loudspeaker approximately 1 m farther away.
sound.motion: Automatic level modulation across the two fixed speakers gives the impression of approach.

tactile_target.apparatus: A custom tapper drops a small 4 mm magnet.

response.target: Press a button with the left hand as quickly as possible on feeling the tap.
response.catch: Withhold on a trial without a tap.

analysis.outcome: Paired-trial tactile RT by auditory onset delay and group. Delays are ordinal proximity conditions.
analysis.table: Use delay-level statistics in Table 3. The article also reports individual linear slopes.
analysis.gap: Published interaction statistics and reported degrees of freedom cannot resolve the original analysis code or preprocessing.

preview.sound: Reuse the packaged three-second Maister 2015 digital looming proxy. Mul cites that task’s apparatus. The Mul source duration, level and envelope are unreported.
preview.allocation: Group all 65 events in one inspection pool with a seeded shuffle. Original block boundaries and realized trial order are unreported.
preview.response: The inspection represents mechanical tap timing with a tactile-channel marker and left-hand button response semantics.

implementation_gaps: The original pink-noise waveform, playback duration, calibrated two-speaker routing and level envelopes are unavailable.
The tactile scheduler needs the original or measured equivalent 4 mm magnet tapper, calibrated mechanical contact onset and a synchronized left-hand response button.
The exact original ITI, trial randomization and online response deadline are unreported.

provenance.field: Cohorts, task order, apparatus, delays and allocation
